item.herocraft.mjolnir.flavor.line3: shall possess the power of Thor.
Enhanced physiology: devastating melee force, mobility, grabbing and tanking damage.
Drink the serum, then take an electrical surge from an Overloaded Redstone Coil (or a natural lightning strike).
Heavy melee strike with high damage and knockback.
Smash the ground for a radial shockwave that damages and launches nearby entities.
Charge briefly, then launch toward where you are looking.
Massive charged ground punch with a large shockwave and cosmetic terrain cracking.
Grab a valid mob/player/object; activate again to hurl it where you aim.
Toggle a defensive stance: high knockback resistance and damage reduction, less speed.
Unarmed hits deal 7 damage; a held tool adds its own damage on top
herocraft.power.power_02_laser_vision.de: A photonic mutation turning the eyes into precision tools, combat beams and high-output weapons.
herocraft.power.power_02_laser_vision.tr: Drink the serum and look into an active Experimental Light Projector / Beacon Lens for several seconds.
herocraft.power.power_02_laser_vision.ab: Hold to fire two continuous energy streams from your eyes that damage and ignite targets.
Narrow, high-damage beam with longer range and limited block-cutting.
Instant short-range eye blast that knocks nearby enemies away.
Sustained full-power beam with extreme damage, fire and an impact burst.
Low-power utility beam: light TNT, melt ice/snow, break glass.
Toggle thermal highlighting of nearby living entities, through limited cover.
herocraft.power.power_02_laser_vision.pa: Subtle red eye glow while charged
herocraft.power.power_03_flight.name: Flight
herocraft.power.power_03_flight.desc: True superhero aerial movement: dashes, hovering and high-speed bursts.
herocraft.power.power_03_flight.trigger: Drink the serum on an activated Unstable Gravity Plate or inside a Gravity Distortion Rig.
Rapid forward aerial dash that preserves momentum.
Accelerate downward; hitting the ground creates an impact shockwave scaled to dive speed.
Up to 25s of maximum-speed flight trailing a roaring vapour wake, throwing 9-damage shockwaves. Press again to end it early; the cooldown only starts once it ends.
Scoop up the creature or player you are looking at and carry them with you as you fly; press again to set them down.
Powerful vertical launch that immediately gains altitude.
Reduced fall damage while flight is unlocked
herocraft.power.power_04_super_speed.des: A speedster mutation: traversal, combat bursts, evasion and momentum.
herocraft.power.power_04_super_speed.tri: Drink the serum and sprint across a run of powered/charged copper plates.
herocraft.power.power_04_super_speed.abi: Dash to the targeted enemy and strike at high speed.
A burst of multiple rapid strikes to nearby valid targets.
Instant directional dodge based on current movement. In speed modes, jumps also keep their momentum for long leaps.
For 25s: +500% speed, +150% attack speed, fall immunity, and every Super Speed move hits twice as hard. Stacks with Speed Mode (50s cooldown).
Hold to spin (up to 8s), flinging back enemies and projectiles and putting out fire. 8s cooldown on release.
Toggle: +300% speed, +50% attack speed, run on water, 2-block step, +100% swim speed, -80% fall damage. Sprinting while it is on leaves a speed trail at your feet. Stacks with Overdrive.
herocraft.power.power_05_geokinesis.name: Geokinesis
herocraft.power.power_05_geokinesis.desc: Control stone, dirt and earth as a battlefield weapon and defensive tool.
herocraft.power.power_05_geokinesis.trig: Drink while standing on natural stone/deepslate, ideally in a Geological Resonance Chamber.
herocraft.power.power_05_geokinesis.abil: Rip a small rock from the ground and fire it as a projectile.
Cause stone spikes to erupt beneath the targeted location.
A 4x4 rock wall for 25s. Look up for a dome (left-click it to drop it), look down for a bridge, sneak + look down for 20s of rock flight.
Large seismic pulse that damages, disrupts and launches nearby entities.
Pull a large temporary boulder from the ground and hold it for an aimed throw.
Toggle stone plating: heavy defense, reduced speed, and +8 damage to every Geokinesis move. Drains a strain bar (~25s) that recharges on its own once dropped.
herocraft.power.power_05_geokinesis.pass: Improved mining speed on stone/earth while ability energy is available
An amethyst/crystal power set: sharp projectiles, prisons, barriers and reflective armor.
Drink inside a natural Amethyst Geode or a functioning crystal chamber.
Fire a fast, sharp crystal projectile.
Grow a cluster of crystals beneath targeted enemies.
Create a temporary translucent crystal shield.
Amethyst shards erupt from the ground across an 8-block radius (they crumble away after a few seconds) and everything caught takes heavy damage.
Seal a target in an amethyst cage for 7s with Slowness X and a jump lock — they cannot move at all.
Toggle crystal plating: defense, knockback resistance, and +10 damage to every Crystalkinesis move. Drains a strain bar (~25s) that recharges once dropped.
Reduced damage from amethyst/crystal hazards you create
A general electricity mutation - intentionally weaker than Thor’s true lightning.
Drink the serum and activate an Overloaded Redstone Coil while inside its discharge radius.
Fire a quick 8-damage electrical bolt that leaves the target static-shocked — hard-slowed and weakened, with crackling sparks around them.
Strike a target for 8, then arc to every other target it can reach within 8 blocks of each link. Static-shocks everything it hits.
Short high-speed electrical dash with brief collision immunity.
Call down one enormous bolt at the aimed point for 60 damage, blasting a small crater and leaving anything hit hard-slowed for 8+ seconds.
Energise redstone from up to 50 blocks away — plants a short-lived block of redstone against whatever you are looking at.
Toggle: +10 damage to every move, Speed III, and a live-current body. Drains a charge bar (~25s); getting hit while charged costs you 5 health and staggers you.
Attacks leave targets static-shocked (slow + weakness + visible sparks); some moves power redstone
herocraft.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.des: Direct heat and flame control: ranged fire, mobility and an aggressive flame-body stance.
herocraft.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.tri: Drink the serum and remain in ordinary fire for several seconds while resistance protects you.
herocraft.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.abi: Launch a compact explosive fire projectile.
Hold to project continuous flame. The heat gauge climbs while you fire (~13s to overheat, then it cuts out); it vents back down whenever you are not firing.
Use a fire burst to launch rapidly where you aim.
A large fiery eruption around you with heavy damage and ignition.
A flint-and-steel in your hand: light fires, TNT, campfires and nether portals. Sneak + use to pull in nearby fire and cook every raw item in your hand.
Toggle a flame aura: fire immunity, +2 melee, a trail of fire underfoot, and everything within 3 blocks catches alight. Bleeds the heat reserve (~35s), which refills once dropped.
herocraft.power.power_08_pyrokinesis.pas: Strong or permanent fire resistance depending on balance mode
herocraft.power.power_09_cryokinesis.des: Ice control: freezing, terrain creation, defensive walls and fast ice traversal.
herocraft.power.power_09_cryokinesis.tri: Drink the serum while submerged in Powder Snow for several seconds.
herocraft.power.power_09_cryokinesis.abi: Fire a chilling projectile that builds freeze on targets.
Hold a beam that freezes and slows enemies and snuffs out fire. Channelling chills you — the cold gauge climbs (~4s to frostbite, then the beam cuts out) and thaws back down while idle.
Conjure ice underfoot (even in mid-air) and skate 150% faster. Jump to rise, hold sneak to descend.
Freeze entities and water in a large radius and extinguish fire.
Create a large temporary wall of ice.
Toggle ice plating: defense, melee attackers freeze, enemies within 5 blocks are slowed, and you leave a dusting of snow as you walk. Bleeds the cold reserve (~35s), which refills once dropped.
herocraft.power.power_10_telekinesis.des: Psionic force manipulation: push, pull, levitate, grab and weaponize entities or blocks.
herocraft.power.power_10_telekinesis.tri: Drink the serum near an active Enchanting Table with enough bookshelves to trigger a psionic resonance.
herocraft.power.power_10_telekinesis.abi: Launch targeted or nearby entities away.
Pull targeted entities or items toward you.
Levitate telekinetically. Burns the Telekinetic Energy bar the whole time (~17s from full); holding a grabbed target or block drains it too.
Seize nearby loose targets and violently throw them outward.
Hold a target in the air; primary throws, secondary slams, aim controls position.
Lift selected compatible blocks as temporary throwables.
herocraft.power.power_10_telekinesis.pas: Nearby dropped items drift slightly toward you while charged
herocraft.power.power_11_teleportation.d: Short-range spatial distortion: combat blinks, marks and limited wall phasing.
herocraft.power.power_11_teleportation.t: Drink the serum and throw/use an Ender Pearl while the effect is active.
herocraft.power.power_11_teleportation.a: Short teleport toward the crosshair, stopping safely before invalid blocks.
Teleport to a safe position behind a targeted enemy.
Instant short teleport backward from your facing.
Rapidly blink between nearby enemies and strike each valid target.
Place one return marker; activate again to return if the spot is still valid. Works across dimensions — a marker set in the Nether always brings you back to the Nether, wherever you press the key.
Short teleport through a thin wall with strict distance and safety checks.
Aggressive cellular regeneration: constant passive healing that hunger and combat can't stop.
While the serum is active, survive being reduced below 3 hearts without dying.
Instantly restore a burst of health.
Remove selected negative effects such as Poison, Weakness and Slowness.
Immediate recovery and short resistance after heavy recent damage.
Automatic: dying triggers full totem-of-undying protection, then a one-minute cooldown. Nothing to press.
An extra 0.5 HP every 0.5s for 30 seconds on top of your regeneration, plus a movement and mining boost.
Toggle an extra 0.5 HP every 0.5s; the only Super Regeneration ability that burns hunger (saturation every 5s).
Passive regeneration of 1 HP per second, unaffected by hunger or combat
herocraft.power.power_13_super_durabilit: A tank mutation hardening the body against damage, knockback, projectiles and explosions.
Drink the serum and survive an explosion from TNT or a controlled blast chamber.
Reinforced melee hit with extra stagger.
Rush forward through enemies, dealing collision damage and knockback.
Hold to cut damage from the frontal 180° arc by a further 60%; drains the guard bar.
Ignore 100% of all damage for 15 seconds.
Hold to swat away nearby projectiles and be immune to them; drains the guard bar.
Toggle a reinforced stance: a further 30% damage reduction and knockback resistance, lower speed.
30% less damage from all sources, with extra reduction vs fall and explosions
herocraft.power.power_14_sonic_scream.de: Manipulate destructive sound: cones, focused blasts, mobility and sonar-like utility.
herocraft.power.power_14_sonic_scream.tr: Use a Goat Horn while the serum is active, ideally inside a resonant room/chamber.
herocraft.power.power_14_sonic_scream.ab: A quick cone-shaped sound attack for 10 damage with knockback. 5s cooldown.
A long-range concentrated sonic beam for 16 damage. 10s cooldown.
Blast sound downward to launch into the air — and take no fall damage from the landing.
A devastating 20-block cone of sound ahead of you for 35 damage, with severe knockback and glass-breaking.
Vibrate selected fragile/compatible blocks until they break.
Toggle sonar that outlines nearby living entities — visible only to you, never to other players.
herocraft.power.power_15_invisibility_li: Bend light for stealth, flashes, mirages and limited offensive photonic attacks.
Drink under direct sunlight with an unobstructed sky for several seconds.
Fire a compact burst of concentrated light for 10 damage.
Sear nearby enemies for 8 damage and blind and slow them for 10 seconds.
Hold to fly wherever you look; your body scatters into light while it lasts. Drains the sparkle meter (~25s), which refills on its own. 3s cooldown once you land.
Channel a single blinding pillar of light for 3 seconds — heavy continuous beam damage plus periodic radiant bursts where it lands.
Create a temporary visual duplicate that attracts hostile attention.
Sustained full invisibility — your armour vanishes too, so nothing shows. Attacking or heavy damage briefly reveals you.
herocraft.power.power_16_spider_climbing: Cling to any surface and move across it. Turn the grip on, then double-tap jump against a wall or ceiling to grab it -- climb up, crawl sideways, hang still, and double-tap sneak (or jump) to let go. Slower and less sure-footed than the arachnid who evolves out of it.
Get hit by a Cave Spider while the serum is active and survive the poison.
Hit a target and briefly stick/root it against a nearby surface.
Launch toward the aimed target or surface.
Powerfully launch away from the surface you are gripping.
Temporary enhanced agility: rapid climbing, wall-running, attack speed and leaps.

Arm the grip. With it on, double-tap jump against a wall or ceiling to stick, then look where you want to go and move relative to the surface. Stop and you stay put; sneak and you hold tighter. Double-tap sneak, or reach the ground, to let go.
The same grip, armed permanently -- double-tap jump against walls, overhangs and ceilings to hold them, double-tap sneak or jump to let go.
herocraft.power.power_17_elasticity.name: Elasticity
herocraft.power.power_17_elasticity.desc: Rubber-like body manipulation: ranged punches, bouncing, grabs and slingshot movement.
herocraft.power.power_17_elasticity.trig: While affected, fall at least 10 blocks onto a Slime Block and survive the rebound.
herocraft.power.power_17_elasticity.abil: Extend both arms for a heavy forward smash.
Anchor to a surface and launch your body forward.
Massively enlarge an arm and slam the ground for an area hit.
Stretch an arm to pull a mob, player or item toward you.
Toggle elastic physics: +reach, +speed, Jump Boost, attackers bounce off you, and you rebound off the ground like a slime block on every landing — the harder the fall, the bigger the bounce.
herocraft.power.power_18_density_manipul: Switch between low and high density for mobility, heavy impacts, defense and limited phasing.
Activate a Molecular Compression Chamber while the serum is active.
Momentarily increase fist density for a powerful strike.
Become extremely heavy and crash downward.
Lower density and dash through entities and very thin obstacles.
Rise slowly, invulnerable, dragging every nearby creature in; anything within 6 blocks is crushed for 15 damage a second. Lasts 25s.

Toggle: vibrate and walk straight through solid blocks while the phase meter lasts. You are immune to all damage while phasing. Hold position on entry — jump to rise, sneak to sink; your head buried in a block costs air.
Cycle Normal → Heavy → Light: damage/defense vs mobility.
Mode-dependent jump, fall speed and knockback modifiers
herocraft.power.power_19_shadow_manipula: Use darkness as a resource for bolts, tendrils, movement, clones and concealment.
Drink at night while standing in true darkness (light level 0) for several seconds.
Fire a dark-energy bolt for 8 damage that blinds the target for 7 seconds.
Lash nearby enemies for 10 damage, blinding them for 7 seconds and dragging them in.
A plain 25-block blink in the direction you are looking. 4s cooldown (halved in darkness).
25s of a personal darkness field with speed and strength; the bar shows time left. Press again to end early — the 50s cooldown only starts once it ends.
Pin the target in place and blind them for 7 seconds, wrapped in a shroud of shadow.
Toggle stealth bonuses in darkness: partial invisibility, speed, reduced mob detection.
Stronger ability regeneration in darkness; weaker in bright sunlight
herocraft.power.power_20_energy_absorpti: Convert incoming heat, explosions and electricity into a stored meter for offensive discharge.
While the serum is active, survive at least two different energy-like damage sources.
Spend a little stored energy on a ranged 8-damage bolt.
Spend stored energy on a sustained beam.
A short charged lunge with brief damage resistance. 3s cooldown.
Detonate all stored energy: 1 damage for every percent the 500-point bar is charged, and the blast (and crater) grows the fuller it is.
Hold while looking at a powered block (redstone, glowstone, lava, lit campfire) to siphon it into your meter. Also acts as an absorption shield while held. 3s cooldown on release.
Toggle passive partial absorption of fire, lightning, explosions and energy attacks. Bleeds the meter very slowly and charges your melee hits with an energy jolt.
500-point Energy Meter; high charge produces a cosmetic aura
herocraft.power.power_21_shockwave_manip: Amplify kinetic force into pressure waves, repulsion and charged impacts.
Drink the serum and survive a TNT explosion or controlled blast chamber.
Punch to send a short pressure wave forward for 8 damage.
Strike the ground and send a traveling shockwave along the surface for 12 damage.
Blast yourself up and forward like a super-leap — no fall damage on landing. Built Charge launches you further.
Release a huge spherical shockwave around you for 35 damage.
Hold to keep a bubble up that constantly shoves entities and projectiles away. Drains a repulsion bank (~13s) that refills while not held.
Hold to build kinetic energy; the next Shockwave Punch, Ground Wave, Recoil Jump or Kinetic Detonation gains extra strength and range.
Slight knockback resistance from internal kinetic control
herocraft.power.power_22_plant_manipulat: Control vines, roots and rapid growth for crowd control, movement, protection and regeneration.
Drink beneath open sky while surrounded by natural plant blocks, flowers or saplings.
Fire a sharp plant projectile for 8 damage and Poison II for 8 seconds.
Vines seize a target for 12 damage and root them in place for 8 seconds.
Attach a vine line to a block up to 100 blocks away and swing toward it.
Explosive growth in a 10-block radius: 27 damage, Poison V for 10 seconds, and a dense thicket that recedes after a few seconds.
Conjure a wall of leaves — look up for a dome, look down for a bridge. Sneak instead to charge your touch with bone meal for 30 seconds.
Toggle: while standing on grass/moss or within 5 blocks of any plant or leaf, gain Regeneration II and +8 to all ability and melee damage.
Bone meal interactions are more efficient
herocraft.power.power_23_gravity_manipul: Control local gravity to push, crush, levitate and create dangerous gravity wells.
Drink inside an active Gravity Distortion Rig or complete a controlled low-gravity drop test.
A focused gravity pulse that throws targets away for 9 damage.
Pin a target under crushing gravity for 10 seconds — 4 damage a second and slowed the whole time.
Temporarily reduce personal gravity for floating and aerial repositioning.
Become a black hole for 12 seconds: invulnerable, dragging every creature within 10 blocks inward and crushing whatever comes close for 15 damage a second. You stay grounded.
Lift the target in front of you and hold it on your aim; activate again to hurl it.
Cycle personal Low / Normal / High gravity with different mobility and combat effects.
Reduced fall damage in Low gravity mode
herocraft.power.power_24_wind_manipulati: Air-pressure control: blades, tornadoes, flight-like movement and projectile defense.
Drink inside an active Pressure Chamber / Industrial Fan Array.
Fire a compressed blade of air.
A roaming funnel that sucks entities in, spins and lifts them, and grinds them for 6 seconds.
Use controlled air currents for limited flight/propulsion.
Create a large violent wind field around you.
A powerful defensive gust that repels mobs and projectiles.
Toggle a supporting wind current: faster movement, high jumps, gliding, and a gust that shoves anything within 2 blocks back by ~1 block. Drains a wind bank (~20s) that refills once dropped.
Reduced fall damage when using wind movement
herocraft.power.power_25_water_manipulat: Control water into projectiles, whips, prisons and movement; be extremely capable underwater.
Drink the serum and remain fully submerged for roughly a minute, or use a Hydrostatic Test Tank.
Tap to fire a high-pressure jet. Sneak and hold 4s to place a water source where you look.
A sweeping water lash that damages and pulls targets.
Fire yourself along a jet of water in a fast forward dash. Goes further while wet, and bowls over anything in the way.
Launch a massive advancing wall of water that knocks back and displaces enemies.
Trap a target in a suspended water sphere for a short duration.
Toggle an enhanced underwater state: water breathing, fast swimming, clear vision.
No drowning while Aquatic Form is active
herocraft.power.power_26_magnetic_manipu: Manipulate magnetically reactive metal for combat and movement. Your abilities require actual magnetic material in the environment or on your enemies. Copper and gold are not magnetically reactive; netherite can be manipulated but strongly resists magnetic force.
Drink between two powered Electromagnetic Coils or inside a Magnetic Test Rig.

Launch a nearby magnetic object — a block you look at, a dropped metal item, or a nearby metal block — toward your crosshair. Heavier objects fly slower but hit far harder (iron nugget ~6, iron block ~18, anvil/netherite block ~28). Fails with no cooldown if there is no magnetic metal in reach.
Grab a magnetic block, dropped item, minecart or iron golem and float it on your aim. Heavier objects follow more sluggishly; netherite resists. Activate again to hurl it forward.

Pull yourself rapidly toward a magnetic object you are looking at, up to 24 blocks. Preserves momentum and cushions the landing briefly — chain leaps between metal to travel. Fails with no cooldown if nothing magnetic is targeted.

Gather up to 8 nearby magnetic objects into a violent orbit, then launch them at whatever you aim toward. Each object's damage scales with its mass; damage to any one target is capped so it can't instantly delete an enemy. Needs at least 2 magnetic objects nearby.

Use the magnetic metal an enemy wears or holds against them — crushing damage that scales with how much they carry (one item ~7, full iron armour ~19), plus Slowness and Weakness, and a hard immobilise at 3+ pieces. Netherite takes less damage but is still locked down. No metal on the target means no effect and no cooldown.

Toggle: highlight nearby magnetically reactive objects — iron blocks and ore, iron bars, chains, anvils, rails, lanterns, minecarts, lodestone, netherite, dropped iron, and metal-equipped enemies. Copper and gold are never highlighted.
Nearby dropped magnetic items drift toward you; controlled objects can't hurt you
Objects you are currently controlling never damage their owner
herocraft.power.power_27_size_manipulati: Change body scale for stealth, mobility or giant strength - neither form universally superior.
Drink inside a Mass Compression Chamber (Government Experiment Sites) or a craftable late-iron-tier version.
Enlarge the striking arm for a wide sweeping hit — its reach scales with how big you are (roughly 4x in Giant form).
Stomp for a ground shockwave whose radius scales with your size (much wider as a giant).
Toggle (X): shrink to about half a block tall. Press again for normal size.

Toggle (Z): become ~15 blocks tall — 15-block reach, +15 damage on every move, 3-block leaps, and creatures you walk over are trampled. Drains a size-strain bar (~23s); once you shrink back it slowly recharges on its own.
While small or normal, rapidly shrink/dash through a narrow gap or under attacks.
Toggle (C): grow to about 6 blocks tall — 6-block reach, a wide pickup radius, and 3-block leaps. Press again for normal size.
Form-dependent reach, speed, step height and hitbox changes

herocraft.guide.overview.body: HeroPack turns Minecraft into a superhero sandbox. Alongside iconic heroes like Thor, you can undergo experimental mutations to permanently gain one of 27 minor powers, each with six abilities on a shared control scheme.
herocraft.guide.controls.title: Controls
herocraft.guide.controls.body: Every power uses the same six ability keys. What each key does depends on your active power (or on Thor, when you hold Mjolnir).
herocraft.guide.controls.select: H   HeroPack: Select Power - switch which mutation occupies the six slots. Never uses R/G/X/Z/V/C.
herocraft.guide.controls.info: I   Your Power - open a quick reference for your active power and its six abilities.
herocraft.guide.mutation.body: 1. Study a research note to learn a mutation exists. 2. Craft the power’s reagent from obscure materials, then brew it with the listed base potion to make an unstable serum. 3. Drink the serum — you gain a temporary Unstable Mutation. 4. Before it fades, perform the required exposure event (a dangerous accident, or a laboratory device). 5. Survive it and the power is yours forever: UNUSUAL MUTATION DETECTED.
herocraft.guide.mutation.capacity: You may permanently own up to 3 minor mutations (server-configurable). Only one occupies the six ability slots at a time — switch with the power wheel. Switching never resets cooldowns or duplicates passives. Experimental mutations and a Hero-Tier power (Thor, Iron Man, Spider-Man, Max Steel) cannot be held at once: a mutated body rejects the Arc Reactor, the Steel and the Arachnid Mutagen, and taking a serum does nothing once you are a Hero. Give up your powers with a Power Suppressor to switch paths.
herocraft.guide.mutation.research: Research advances: Research Found → Serum Stabilized → Exposure Survived → Mutation Confirmed. Once confirmed, the full recipe is permanently recorded and reproducible for teammates.
herocraft.guide.structures.body: Six rare structures generate above ground across the Overworld. Explore to find them; each holds research notes, thematic ingredients and usually a laboratory device.
herocraft.guide.structure.research_facil: Brewing gear, copper/redstone machinery and a light projector. Linked to Flight, Laser Vision, Telekinesis, Wind and Gravity research.
A scorched crater with an unusual central crystal. Linked to Energy Absorption, Flight, Laser Vision and Density.
Coils, generators and an Overloaded Redstone Coil. Linked to Electrokinesis, Super Speed, Super Strength and Magnetism.
herocraft.guide.structure.geological_sit: Lapis, amethyst and resonance equipment. Linked to Geokinesis, Crystalkinesis and Density.
herocraft.guide.structure.government_sit: A rare fenced compound with prototype compression machines. Linked to Density, Size and Gravity.

herocraft.guide.combos.body: Owning two complementary powers unlocks synergies (they apply passively where relevant):
herocraft.guide.thor.body: Thor is a Hero-Tier path, rarer and stronger than any minor mutation. Prove worthy, bind Mjolnir (sneak + right-click) to gain the Power of Thor (+10 melee, +10 hearts, permanent Resistance III, 250 Storm Energy). While holding Mjolnir: R Call Mjolnir, G Lightning Strike, X Lightning Beam (held), Z God of Thunder's Wrath, V Thunderclap (10 Storm Energy), C Chain Lightning. God of Thunder's Wrath is an 80-damage bolt at the point you are aiming at — it cannot be cast instantly: hold Z for 5 seconds to charge it (a bar shows the buildup), and it drains 150 Storm Energy. Double-tap jump while holding Mjolnir to fly. You cannot hold Thor's power and an experimental mutation at the same time.

herocraft.guide.iron_man.body: Craft an Arc Reactor and right-click it to become Tony Stark. Tony Stark grants the knowledge to build and operate advanced Iron Man technology — the Stark Fabricator, Stark components, and the Iron Man suit progression. Without the Tony Stark power, Stark technology simply does not respond: the Fabricator will not open, and Iron Man armour is ejected from unauthorized wearers.

herocraft.guide.iron_man.recipes: The Stark Fabricator needs Stark energy (charge it with Reactor Cores or an Arc Reactor). Advanced components and every suit piece are fabricated there, never in a normal crafting table. Building a mark chestplate advances the technology tree so the next blueprint can be fabricated.
herocraft.guide.iron_man.controls: Wearing a suit, the six ability keys become Repulsor (tap; hold 2s for a Charged Repulsor) / Repulsor Shield (blocks most frontal damage) / Micro-Missiles / Unibeam / Mob Highlight toggle / Suit Toggle. Double-tap jump in the air to fly (except the Mark I, which flies only via its own ability). Unarmoured, the Suit Toggle key opens the Call Armour picker (or double-tap jump on the ground to call your best suit) — it works even if the Suit Platform is far away in an unloaded chunk, in the same dimension.

herocraft.guide.zombie_raid.body: Somewhere out there is a Graveyard, and somewhere in the dark is a Cursed Zombie. Either one can make you Gravebound — and twenty minutes later, the dead come for you.
herocraft.guide.zombie_raid.curse.body: Twenty minutes of play. It survives logging out, dying, changing dimension, restarting the game, and milk. Only an Enchanted Golden Apple breaks it — everything else just delays the reckoning. The timer shows in the top-left while it runs.
herocraft.guide.zombie_raid.sources.body: Activate the Cursed Grave in a Graveyard's crypt, or take a hit from a rare Cursed Zombie. Both lead to exactly the same curse: a second source never resets, extends or stacks your timer.
herocraft.guide.zombie_raid.waves.body: Risen and baby zombies, Armoured Zombies that shrug off arrows, Acid Zombies that deny ground, Sword Skeletons that hunt archers, and Juggernauts that charge. Powered Zombie Bosses arrive on waves 4, 8 and 12, each carrying one of the Experimental Powers.
herocraft.guide.zombie_raid.bosses.body: An Empowered Zombie fights with a real power, not a bigger health bar. It picks its targets, follows fliers, closes on archers and saves its area attacks for crowds. Kill one and you take a Corrupted Power Core that remembers which power it had, plus research progress toward it.
herocraft.guide.zombie_raid.rewards.body: Grave Essence from everything you kill; a Cursed Grave Chest after wave 12, holding the final boss's core and — if you are lucky — a Gravewalker Charm, a Gravekeeper Shield, a Necrotic Blade or an Undying Totem. Your first clear also yields a Heart of the Grave.
herocraft.guide.zombie_raid.repeat.body: Craft the Heart of the Grave into a Grave Ritual Totem with Grave Essence, Soul Sand, Rotten Flesh and a Skeleton Skull. Use it in a Graveyard to curse yourself deliberately.
herocraft.guide.supervillain_raid.body: A rare assault on a village by one of three Supervillains and their raider army. It is not a vanilla raid, and it does not happen often — most players will go a long time between sightings of the scout that starts it.
herocraft.guide.supervillain_raid.spy.bo: Every so often a lone Pillager appears in the wild, sometimes with an escort, and heads for the nearest village. Look closely: the robe is darker, a faint purple particle drifts from it now and then, and its name shows on your crosshair. It is scouting the village for a Supervillain.
herocraft.guide.supervillain_raid.mark.b: If the Spy manages to land a hit on a player who is standing inside a village, that village is Marked for Attack. A miss does nothing; an ordinary Pillager does nothing; a hit outside the village does nothing. The mark belongs to the village, and a village that survives a raid is safe from another for a few days.
herocraft.guide.supervillain_raid.prepar: Once marked, you have 10 minutes before the first wave. Warnings sound at 10, 5 and 1 minute and count down the final seconds. Use the time to build defences, protect the villagers, gather supplies, equip your gear and call for help. Leaving the village does not cancel the attack.
Five escalating waves of Pillagers, Vindicators, Witches, Evokers and Ravagers, each cleared before the next begins with 15 seconds to regroup. Wave 5 is the largest conventional wave.
herocraft.guide.supervillain_raid.villai: After wave 5 everything goes quiet. Then: SOMETHING POWERFUL IS APPROACHING. One of three villains arrives — the Chimera, the Arsenal or the Omega Mage — carrying a completely unpredictable superhero power, with a small escort. The appearance never tells you the power. Defeat the villain and the remaining raiders flee.
herocraft.guide.supervillain_raid.reward: The Supervillain drops a large amount of experience, emeralds and a Villain Cache of high-level loot, and has a chance to drop a Supervillain Token, a Power Fragment of its power, and its unique trophy (Chimera Core, Arsenal Reactor or Omega Crystal). Everyone who fought becomes Champion of the Village for 30 minutes — improved village trades.

herocraft.spider_man.name: Spider-Man
herocraft.spider_man.desc: A Hero Class built entirely around movement. Swing across the sky, crawl over anything, and see trouble coming before it arrives.
herocraft.spider_man.ability.web_swing.d: Hold to fire a web and swing from it. Finds real anchors -- rooftops, cliffs, canopy, cave ceilings -- and fires one high ahead of you when there is nothing to catch. W builds momentum, S brakes, A and D steer, jump reels in, sneak lets out. Let go at the right moment and you keep every bit of the speed.
herocraft.spider_man.ability.web_zip.des: Fire at the surface you are looking at -- up to 100 blocks away -- and pull yourself to it, fast. Precision traversal: rooftops, ledges, the far side of a ravine, or a save on the way down.
herocraft.spider_man.ability.web_shot.de: A burst of webbing at what you are aiming at -- 2 damage, no cooldown, 2 webbing a shot. Every hit is a stickiness stack (max 3) that slows the target and weighs its jump down, worse each time; land the next hit within 3 seconds of the first to build it. The third stack wraps an ordinary mob in a full web cocoon for 12 seconds. Puts out fires, including your own.
herocraft.spider_man.ability.web_yank.de: Line something and haul. Light things come to you, heavy things pull you to them, and dropped items come flying -- from a ravine, a lava edge or anywhere you would rather not walk.
Toggle. While on, touching any climbable surface in mid-air sticks you to it automatically -- no double-tap needed -- and sneaking locks you to that exact spot like a ladder rung. (Double-tap jump against a surface still works with it off.)
herocraft.spider_man.ability.web_net.des: Spin a temporary platform of webbing where you are aiming. A bridge, a floor, a landing pad or a trap. Dissolves on its own and puts back whatever it covered.
herocraft.spider_man.ability.web_blossom: Sneak and hold V for 3 seconds, then leap into the air and fire webbing in every direction. Everything within 20 blocks takes 40 damage and is trapped in cobwebs -- frozen in place -- for 20 seconds. Spends your entire web reserve.

herocraft.guide.spider_man.body: You cannot become Spider-Man directly. It is what Spider Climbing / Adhesion grows into: the same adaptation, refined until it is something else. Everything Adhesion could do, this does better, and it replaces it outright -- you are never carrying both.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.step.adhesion: Mutate into Spider Climbing / Adhesion the ordinary way (Adhesive Mutation Serum, then survive a Cave Spider bite).
herocraft.guide.spider_man.step.mutagen: Craft an Arachnid Mutagen: phantom membrane, an echo shard, spider eyes, fermented spider eyes, amethyst and a golden apple.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.step.evolve: Use it. With the adaptation already in you it evolves; without it, nothing happens and the mutagen is not consumed.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.passive.sense: Spider Sense -- a chime and a crosshair pulse point you at trouble before it lands: an attack winding up, a projectile closing in, a primed explosion, a bad fall, lava or a falling block. Move, jump or crouch during the warning for a guaranteed dodge.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.passive.dodge: Half of all incoming attacks are simply dodged; a dodged projectile is caught, or sometimes flung back.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.passive.arrow: Arrows you dodge are caught out of the air and kept.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.passive.crawl: Wall crawling -- double-tap jump against a surface to grab it, then look where you want to go and move. Double-tap sneak, or reach the ground, to let go. Toggle Wall Crawl (C) to make surfaces stick automatically.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.passive.ceili: Ceiling crawling, and clean transitions between wall and ceiling in both directions.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.passive.wall_: Jump while clung to a wall to launch about 7 blocks in the exact direction you are looking, with a slight upward kick -- a wall leap.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.passive.doubl: A second jump in mid-air, once every second.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.passive.super: Sneak and jump from the ground to leap about 10 blocks straight up.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.passive.web_b: Web Blossom -- sneak and hold V for 3 seconds, then leap into the air and blast webbing outward. Everything within 20 blocks takes 40 damage and is frozen in cobwebs for 20 seconds. Spends your whole Web Reserve.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.passive.stren: An unarmed hit lands 8 damage (a sprint punch, 10), plus Speed II, Resistance II, a jump that clears 2 blocks, and solid resistance to being knocked around.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.passive.fall: Falls hurt far less, and a fall you web out of does not hurt at all.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.passive.reser: Organic webbing -- no shooters, no ammunition, just a reserve that refills.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.swinging: Swinging prefers real terrain and always will: a city, a mountainside or a dense forest gives longer, faster, more dramatic arcs than open ground. Where there is genuinely nothing to catch, the web goes up and ahead anyway so traversal never stops -- but those swings will only carry you so far above where the run began, so webbing across a desert stays swinging rather than becoming flying. Climb real terrain and that limit rises with you.
herocraft.guide.spider_man.reserve: Every web ability spends from your Web Reserve, shown under the ability row. Swinging costs very little; combat webbing costs real amounts. It refills by itself a moment after you stop using it.

herocraft.guide.max_steel.body: Maxwell McGrath generates raw T.U.R.B.O. Energy but cannot control it. Steel -- an alien Ultralink -- bonds with him to regulate that energy, form a nanotech suit around him, and channel it into specialised Turbo Modes.
herocraft.guide.max_steel.step.find: Find a Steel Crash Site -- a rare crater in the open Overworld with Steel floating at its centre. Use /locate structure herocraft:steel_crash_site if you have permission.
herocraft.guide.max_steel.step.bond: Right-click Steel while at Experience Level 30 or higher (this consumes 5 levels), or while carrying a T.U.R.B.O. Stabilizer (this consumes the Stabilizer, with no level requirement). The bond is permanent.
herocraft.guide.max_steel.energy.body: A pool of 250 that regenerates on its own -- 18/second out of combat, 9/second in combat, and not at all while a Turbo Mode is draining it or the Turbo Cannon is charging. If a Turbo Mode drains it to 0 you overload: you drop to Base Mode and cannot use any ability until natural regen brings T.U.R.B.O. Energy back up to 150. Turbo Modes have no time limit -- this pool is the only clock on them.
herocraft.guide.max_steel.controls: Press N to Go Turbo. Press Shift+H while transformed to power down (not in combat); press H alone to retract or seal the helmet. The HUD shows the six abilities with their cooldowns, the active mode, a T.U.R.B.O. Energy meter and whether you are IN COMBAT or READY. The six abilities only work while transformed -- and pressing a mode key (G/X/Z/V) while unsuited armours you up straight into that mode:
herocraft.guide.max_steel.ability.turbo_: Tap to fire a thick, fast T.U.R.B.O. energy bolt (10 damage) -- a real projectile now, not a hitscan. Hold to charge -- particles gather on your hand -- up to 22 damage with a small impact burst on hit.

Reconfigure into a heavier, 20%-larger form: Resistance I, +8 unarmed damage, but slower to move and swing. Crouch to brace and block 50% of incoming damage. Sprint into a melee hit for a Heavy Punch shockwave. Press G again for a Turbo Slam -- 15 damage to everything within 5 blocks. Shift+G returns to Base Turbo Mode.

Very high, controllable ground speed with automatic step-up (+4 unarmed damage, as Base). Tap again while active for a short Turbo Dash that hits the first thing in front of you; Shift+X returns to Base Turbo Mode.
Toggle flight -- blue T.U.R.B.O. wings deploy and an energy trail streams behind you. Movement keys steer, jump climbs, sneak drops, sprint boosts. Costs more the faster you go.
Near-total invisibility -- the suit fades, nearby hostiles lose track of you. Breaks the moment you attack or take a real hit, then goes on a 12-second cooldown.

Hold to brace and charge, release to launch yourself forward as a living cannonball. Instant-cast hits for 12; every extra second charged (up to 5) adds 5 more damage and costs more T.U.R.B.O. Energy. You take none of the impact yourself.
herocraft.guide.max_steel.passives.body: Diamond-tier suit armour, +4 melee, some knockback resistance, half fall damage, a higher jump, passive Regeneration I, and you breathe underwater. Steel also chirps and marks the direction of a projectile you can't see coming.
herocraft.guide.max_steel.emergency.body: If a hit would kill you while you are NOT transformed, Steel forces the suit online instead: the death is cancelled, you are healed and briefly shielded, and you Go Turbo on the spot. It costs 150 T.U.R.B.O. Energy and then will not fire again for 20 minutes. Being suited up when the blow lands does not trigger it -- power down somewhere safe, not mid-fight, to keep it in reserve.
herocraft.guide.punisher.body: Frank Castle is not superhuman. Everything he brings is a firearm, an explosive, a piece of tactical gear, or the training to use them. A Punisher never runs out of reserve ammunition, reloads faster, handles weapons more steadily, and finishes wounded enemies without hesitation.
herocraft.guide.punisher.step.safehouse: Find a rare Abandoned Vigilante Safehouse -- a buried bunker with a weapon workbench, ammunition, target boards and a Vigilante Training Manual. Locate one with /locate structure herocraft:vigilante_safehouse.
herocraft.guide.punisher.step.training: Right-click the Manual to begin. Objectives: defeat 25 hostiles, 10 of them at range, land 5 firearm headshots, craft a firearm, and defeat a Pillager Captain. Complete them all and you permanently become the Punisher.
herocraft.guide.punisher.ammo: You (the Punisher) have infinite reserve ammunition -- magazines and reloads still matter, but no ammo item is consumed. Anyone else may craft and fire these guns, but must carry the matching ammunition: Handgun Rounds, Rifle Rounds, Shotgun Shells or Sniper Rounds.
herocraft.guide.punisher.ability.arsenal: Tactical Satchel -- press R to open a persistent 9-slot bag for weapons, ammo and gear. It rides with you through death, power changes and dimensions, but only opens while you wear the full Punisher tactical armour. Tap R while holding a gun to reload.
herocraft.guide.punisher.ability.grenade: Frag Grenade -- hold G to cook, release to throw. It bounces, then explodes on its fuse. Hold too long and it goes off in your hand. 12s cooldown.
herocraft.guide.punisher.ability.roll: Tactical Roll -- a quick dive in your movement direction with brief knockback resistance and light damage reduction. Cancels an active reload. 4s cooldown.
herocraft.guide.punisher.ability.suppres: Suppressive Fire -- needs the Assault Rifle. For 4s: far less recoil and spread, a faster fire rate, and Slowness on anything you hit -- but you move slower. 20s cooldown.
herocraft.guide.punisher.ability.adrenal: Adrenaline -- for 20s: Regeneration V (first 3s), Resistance II, Haste II, Speed II, +25% reload speed and +15% firearm damage. Your own game audio dulls while it runs, and you take a Nausea crash for 10s once it wears off. 30s cooldown.
herocraft.guide.punisher.ability.c4: Explosive Charge -- press C at a surface to place a charge (up to 3). Sneak + C detonates every charge you placed. Stronger than a grenade, moderate terrain damage.
herocraft.guide.punisher.passives.body: Weapon Proficiency (infinite reserve, less recoil, faster handling), Faster Reloading (15%, does not stack with Adrenaline), Ballistic Expertise (tighter aim), Headshot Feedback, and No Mercy: +25% firearm damage to a non-boss hostile below 15% health (+10% to a boss).
herocraft.guide.punisher.crafting: Weapons are built from Weapon Parts (iron + copper + redstone), Gun Barrels and a Weapon Scope. The pistol is cheapest; the sniper is the most expensive. The Punisher Tactical Vest, Leggings and Boots (there is no helmet) protect between iron and diamond, and while you hold the power the full set adds 20% projectile-damage reduction, knockback resistance and a little less recoil.
herocraft.guide.symbiote.body: An alien symbiotic lifeform that bonds to a host and covers them in a living black suit, sharing its strength, agility and regeneration -- at the cost of a hostile reaction to loud sound. Unlike the Hero Classes, the Symbiote can bond with any player, whatever else they already are.
herocraft.guide.symbiote.step.find: Find a loose Symbiote -- it drifts free in the world, crashes to earth inside a meteor crater, waits in a hidden research lab, or tears itself free of a rare mutated hostile mob it was riding when that mob dies.
herocraft.guide.symbiote.step.bond: Right-click it. It bonds on the spot. Press H to let the suit take hold, and H again to retract it.
herocraft.guide.symbiote.host.normal: Anyone else becomes a Normal Host: plain black living armour with its own six tendril, mobility and defence abilities.
herocraft.guide.symbiote.host.spider_man: A player who already holds Spider-Man becomes Black Suit Spider-Man instead -- the GeckoLib black suit, keeping every web ability, plus three sneak-modified Symbiote extras layered onto Spider-Man's own keys rather than new ones.
herocraft.guide.symbiote.controls.body: Only a Normal Host uses these six -- Black Suit Spider-Man keeps Spider-Man's own web abilities instead (see below).
Lash a tendril at what you are aiming at. A light target is pulled to you; a heavy one pulls you to it.
herocraft.symbiote.ability.tendril_strik: A short-range tendril lash for real damage and a solid knockback.
herocraft.symbiote.ability.leap.desc: A strong forward-and-up mobility jump. You take no fall damage at all until you next land, however far it carries you.
herocraft.symbiote.ability.grapple.desc: Sneak + X: fire a tendril at whatever you are aiming at within 25 blocks and reel yourself to it. No fall damage on the landing. 3-second cooldown.
herocraft.symbiote.ability.slam.desc: A short-range ground slam that damages and knocks back everything nearby. No terrain damage.
herocraft.symbiote.ability.onslaught.des: The ultimate. Hold for 3 seconds to charge, then release to engulf every nearby enemy in living black symbiote -- blinding and slowing them and decaying them for 10 damage over 5 seconds. 60-second cooldown; releasing early cancels it for free.
herocraft.symbiote.ability.shield.desc: Hold to raise a living shield just in front of you. It works like a real shield -- it stops almost all damage from your front, nothing from the side or back -- and you are slowed while it holds. Drains a 9-second guard bar.
herocraft.symbiote.ability.frenzy.desc: An aggressive burst -- more damage, more speed, more knockback resistance -- with a brief defence dip once it wears off.
herocraft.guide.symbiote.black_suit.body: Sneak + Web Yank's key -- Symbiote Web Tendrils, a tendril pull that costs no web reserve. Sneak + Web Shot's key -- Multi-Tendril Attack, striking up to three nearby enemies at once. Sneak + the wall-crawl toggle's key while airborne -- Slam Enhancement, a stronger aerial ground slam. All three are paced by their own cooldowns, shown in the HUD next to the usual six web-ability boxes.
herocraft.symbiote.ability.symbiote_tend: A Tendril Grab-style pull that costs no web reserve at all -- paced by its own cooldown instead.
herocraft.symbiote.ability.symbiote_mult: Lashes out at up to three nearby enemies at once.
herocraft.symbiote.ability.symbiote_slam: A stronger aerial ground slam, only usable while airborne.
herocraft.guide.symbiote.passive.recover: Symbiote Recovery -- noticeably faster natural regeneration than an ordinary player.
herocraft.guide.symbiote.weakness.sonic: Loud sound briefly disrupts every Symbiote ability.
herocraft.guide.symbiote.weakness.fire: Fire and lava hurt 40% more while suited -- and standing in it for several seconds straight forces the Symbiote to tear itself free and abandon the bond entirely. Get out of the flames.
herocraft.guide.symbiote_spider_man.body: A Symbiote that bonded with an existing Spider-Man: the living black suit over the web-slinger's own gear. Every web ability stays on its usual keys -- the Symbiote layers three sneak-modified extras on top instead of asking for new ones.
herocraft.guide.symbiote_spider_man.pass: +30% melee damage on top of Spider-Man's own strength.
Web Reserve capacity doubled -- a permanent perk of the bond, kept even with the suit retracted.
Symbiote Recovery -- noticeably faster natural regeneration than an ordinary player.
